info.name: Authentication ACH Returns Payment Method Configs API

items.docs: Create the configuration to store a payment method. The configuration contains basic information about the payment method such as an idempotency key and optional information such as billing contact and metadata. If the billing contact is provided in the payment method config, then the web component will not prompt for this data.
